plugins.name: Apache Guacamole
plugins.description: Clientless remote desktop gateway (RDP, VNC, SSH) in the browser. Hub installs ghcr.io/opendevtools-org/guacamole:enterprise, built from flcontainers/guacamole. Default login guacadmin / guacadmin — change it immediately.

plugins.name: API Everything
plugins.description: HTTP API. Hub installs ghcr.io/opendevtools-org/api-everything:enterprise. The image serves the REST API and includes the CLI and the MCP server.
